_comment: Step 1 of the burst workflow (Data Selection), emtk app: the raw TTTR files as a data_table over BurstDataSelectionApp.file_rows. Every column carries a tooltip.

sections.description: The raw TTTR files every later step reads, in order. Click a row to select it (its details appear on the right); Delete removes it. Dropping files or a folder on the window adds them.

columns.tooltip: Position of the file in the workflow.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The file name; hover a row for the full path.

columns.title: Format
columns.tooltip: The file extension (the reader is chosen by the detector setup's file type).

columns.title: MMFDB
columns.tooltip: Whether the file is stored in the MMFDB object store and registered as raw TTTR data.
